scheme_name: Financial Assistance To Inter-Caste Married Couples (Except SC/ST Category)
other_conditions: Must be a resident of Kerala state.
Must be an inter‑caste married couple legally married.
Combined family income must not exceed ₹1,00,000 per year.
Must apply between one year and two years after marriage.
Must sign an agreement and submit it to the LSGI.
Funds must be used for starting a business, purchasing land, or constructing a house.
benefits_summary: One‑time financial assistance of ₹30,000 is provided to eligible inter‑caste married couples.
